tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Raising of seedlings in 8x12 (4200) bags, at Kowalli nursery, under RSPD, Bilagi Range during 2026-27

itemList.description: Raising of 4"x6" seedlings for trasplanting into 8"x12" PBs
Cost of HDPE bags including 18% GST
Procurement of 0.9225 cum. Farm Yard Manure / Compost, 0.9225 cum. of Sand and 1.845 cum of Redearth. (4.20 cum. required for 8"x12" minus 0.51 cum of transplanted 4"x6" bag).
Mixing the ingredients, filling the polythene bags and arranging in rows after scraping the earth.
Transplanting of 4" x 6" size bagged seedlings into 8" x 12" size bags.
Watering to the Polythene bagged seedlings twice a day from 01-12-2026 to 31-03-2027 (121 days).
Shifting and grading the polythene-bagged seedlings.
Procurement of plant protection and growth promotion materials/ compounds, their application, nursery pumpset fuel/maintainence/ electricty bill of pumpset and other unforseen items and charges.
